parsed.rationale: Both participating records in this cluster have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/AudioPlayerAnalyticsTests.swift`. The methods `AudioEnginePlayerAnalyticsTests.capturesPauseEvent` (line 293) and `AudioEnginePlayerAnalyticsTests.capturesStopEvent` (line 310) are structurally similar (Jaccard 0.7) because they exercise analogous but semantically distinct analytics events — pause and stop — which are intentionally separate test cases. Collapsing them into a single parameterised test would obscure the distinct failure signal each event name provides, and the duplication is a normal consequence of per-event test coverage rather than an accidental copy.
